laws.rule: Entrance fees for foreigners: Madaba Archaeological Park JD 3; Mount Nebo JD 3. (No RBA rate for JOD; at the Central Bank of Jordan rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 0.4991 JOD: JD 3 ≈ A$6.01)

Mujib Biosphere Reserve, which spans Madaba and Karak: the official tourism page requires a trained guide for the Canyon and Malaqi waterfall trails and the winter Ibex Trail. It does not state the same guide requirement for the Siq Trail. Contact the service provider for current weather-dependent availability; do not turn the described summer season into guaranteed access.

closures: Madaba Archaeological Museum, Archaeological Park and Church of the Apostles: Winter column (labelled November through April): 08:00-16:00; summer: 08:00-18:30; separate April-May column: 08:00-17:30; Ramadan: 09:00-17:00. The April columns overlap, so confirm the applicable seasonal timetable with the site.
